title: Letter and Atlas
author: Paloma Crane
blurb: Coral Amberdale, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
